# Website Health Check: Robert R. Rickards, DMD

## What we saw on 13 November 2026
- Operating on Google Maps as "Rickards Robert R DDS": 196 Riva Ave, Milltown, NJ 08850, (732) 297-7788, dentist, rated 4.6, open with a 5 PM close.
- rickardsdentistry.com, the practice's old address, now redirects to geometrysspot.com, an unrelated Indonesian-language online slot-gambling page; nothing there mentions the practice.
- The domain is still registered (GoDaddy, expires 6 December 2026, registrar locks shown); the Internet Archive shows the practice's own site on it as recently as 6 June 2026.
- The Google listing has no website attached ("Add website" prompt) and is unclaimed; one directory still shows the broken domain.

## What it means for customers
Anyone who types or clicks the old address lands on a gambling page and may think the office has closed. The phone number on the Google listing is the most reliable route to the practice.

## How to fix it
1. Find out who holds the registrar account, and whether the domain is still in the practice's name (0.5-1.5 hours).
2. Renew before 6 December 2026; registrar locks on the record may mean this needs the registrar's support rather than an online renewal (0.5-1.5 hours).
3. If it is still yours, change the password, add two-factor authentication and remove the redirect (1-3 hours).
4. If it cannot be recovered quickly, stop linking to it, register a new domain (1-2 hours) and build a one-page site with tap-to-call, hours and a request form (3-8 hours).
5. Claim the Google profile and attach the site, then add monitoring (1-2 hours).

## After the fix
Claim the Google Business Profile and attach the new site. It has no website link today, so patients searching the name see only a phone number.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
